01About

Backend engineer with 6+ years building Ruby on Rails systems for enterprise field-operations software, Apple device management, healthcare, and government contracting. Owns REST and GraphQL APIs, SFTP data-ingestion pipelines, Sidekiq background-job infrastructure, and third-party integrations in production, including an MDM platform serving 100K+ users and parsers that handle millions of records a day. Ships AI features to production (RAG, vector search, GPT-4o, LangGraph) and holds the Claude Certified Developer credential. Leads small teams, sets testing standards, and runs sprint planning, grooming, and code review.
